children: KeyCorp posted an investor presentation highlighting 2Q26 / 1H26 financial momentum, capital strength and plans for at least $1.3B of 2026 share repurchases.
Posted investor presentation on Sept 25, 2026; may be used in investor/analyst outreach and is available on the investor relations site.
1H26: revenue $3.917B (up 8% YoY), NII $2.488B (up 10% YoY), diluted EPS $0.88 for 1H26 (28% YoY).
Capital & buybacks: repurchased $341M in 2Q26; expect to repurchase at least $1.3B in 2026; Board authorized up to $3.0B.
NII tailwinds: path to 3.25%+ NIM by 4Q27 from $30B of repricing (swaps, securities, mortgages) and loan recycling.
Strategic growth: record AUM $74B, fee-business momentum (Wealth, IB, Payments), ~$1B planned tech spend and front-line hiring to drive organic growth.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
